title: Ootle Payment Gateway
summary: WooCommerce gateway source for Tari Ootle payment sessions and signed webhooks. November 5 review: README revision 3606ab2 still lists checkout wiring and stealth-output reconciliation as roadmap work. The 22-page October setup guide documents daemon 0.45.0, plugin settings and webhooks, with historical checkout screenshots; these do not establish a current completed integration. Its settings screenshot caption says stealth is enabled with merchant fields filled, but the pictured control is unchecked and those fields are empty. The creator-revised HTTP test shop timed out in the reader and returned a client-blocked navigation in the browser; this does not establish global downtime. Its original Bluesky post returned Post not found. The October 20 shop-browsing clip and last-good review date are retained as historical evidence; no cart, checkout, wallet or payment action was taken. This is a community test shop, not an official Tari storefront. Esmeralda was reset November 2; use the source and current daemon documentation before any integration.
cardSummary: Add Tari payments to WooCommerce using wallet-daemon payment sessions, signed webhooks and order-status updates.
